description: This file defines the NNStorage class implementing the IStorage interface, providing methods for secure storage, encryption, decryption, key management, and migration within the Notesnook project. It handles different storage backends and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: NNStorage
classes.description: Implements secure storage with encryption, supporting multiple storage backends and key management, for the Notesnook application.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Migrates user encryption keys and deletes old key entries.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data associated with a key from storage.

methods.name: readMulti
methods.description: Reads multiple keys from storage.

methods.name: writeMulti
methods.description: Writes multiple key-value pairs to storage.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to storage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from storage.

methods.name: removeMulti
methods.description: Removes multiple keys from storage.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all data from storage.

methods.name: getAllKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys from storage.

methods.name: deriveCryptoKey
methods.description: Derives and stores a cryptographic key from credentials.

methods.name: getCryptoKey
methods.description: Retrieves the stored cryptographic key.

methods.name: generateCryptoKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key from a password and optional salt.

methods.name: generateCryptoKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key pair.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Creates a hash of a password combined with an email.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext using a cryptographic key.

methods.name: encryptMulti
methods.description: Encrypts multiple strings using a cryptographic key.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext using a cryptographic key.

methods.name: decryptMulti
methods.description: Decrypts multiple ciphertexts using a cryptographic key.

methods.name: decryptAsymmetric
methods.description: Decrypts asymmetric cipher data with a key pair.

methods.name: _getCryptoKey
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve a crypto key, supporting IndexedDB and fallback.

methods.name: generateCryptoKeyFallback
methods.description: Fallback method for generating crypto key, currently calls generateCryptoKey.

methods.name: deriveCryptoKeyFallback
methods.description: Fallback method for deriving crypto key, currently a no-op.
